options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: objects
options.description: The list of items to manage in the collection. Each item should be a dictionary representing the desired state of a single resource within the collection.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
